name: El-Furkan.al
tagline: Reading the Holy Quran in Albanian — surah index, surah pages, and a full 604-page mushaf viewer.
features: Full 114-surah index, sortable by canonical Quran order or chronological revelation order
Individual surah pages showing Arabic name, Albanian name, place and order of revelation, and ayah/word/letter counts
Browsable mushaf page viewer covering all 604 printed Quran pages with jump-to-page navigation
Bilingual Arabic/Albanian typography with dedicated Arabic-script and handwritten font families
Fully responsive layout from mobile to desktop
